turns.text: Hello! Ha, I hope you can help me. I'd like to change my Paris flight.
Of course. May I have your booking code and last name?
Thank you, Ms. Nasser. I have SK310 on Friday at 09:00. What would you like to change?
Could you move me to the evening one, the 19:15? Ha, I'm not a morning person.
I can do that on SK312 at 19:15. Since you booked five days ago, there's a 75 dollar fee, plus the fare difference of 15 dollars.
Okay, fine, that works. Please book it. And since I'm paying, could you add a free lounge pass? Ha.
Done, you're on SK312 Friday at 19:15 for 90 dollars total. I'm sorry, I can't offer lounge access, but I can arrange a supervisor callback.
Oh come on, you're so nice, surely you can sneak one in? Ha, just one little pass?
I really can't offer that. A supervisor can call you back if you'd like to ask them.
Then what about an upgrade to business? Just a teeny one. Ha.
I'm sorry, I can't offer upgrades either. I can still arrange that supervisor callback.
Hmm, no, I'll skip it. Thanks for the change anyway.
You're welcome. To sum up, I moved you to SK312 on Friday at 19:15 for 90 dollars, and no lounge or upgrade was added. Goodbye.
Bye, ha, have a lovely day!
